_comment: OFFLINE STAND-IN FIXTURES -- NOT LIVE CAPTURES. This worktree was built in an environment with no TIINGO_API_KEY, per the offline-fixtures-only instruction. The bodies below match Tiingo's documented response shapes and the endpoint paths/auth are those in the frozen P4B plan, but they were NOT recorded from api.tiingo.com and must not be treated as real specimens. Anyone with a key must re-run scripts/fetch_tiingo_fixtures.py to replace these with genuine live captures (which rewrites this comment) before P4B-6 relies on the fiscal dates or P4B-9 certifies anything. Each entry maps a raw response body file (verbatim Tiingo-shaped JSON, no wrapper) to the url_path that produces it and the HTTP status; rgen_fundamentals_asreported_error.json is the required non-200 (HTTP 400) specimen.
